Summary of websites shared in #general:

1. www.informations.com — An article on the latest job report, which brought a mix of relief and concern as unemployment edged down to 7.2%.

2. www.restaurant-zurich.com — Zurich Restaurant is a cozy, alpine-inspired eatery in the heart of the city, renowned for authentic Swiss cuisine. The menu features traditional dishes such as cheese fondue, hearty rösti, and chocolate fondue for dessert. Warm wooden interiors with Swiss memorabilia create a welcoming, rustic atmosphere, and large windows offer stunning panoramic views of the city skyline. Friendly staff in traditional Swiss attire make each visit feel like a journey to the Swiss Alps.

Hi Dora! I visited your personal website (www.dora-website.com). It's a nice, clean introduction to your personal site — it clearly identifies itself as your personal website and makes it easy to get in touch via your email. A couple of suggestions if you'd like to make it more engaging: add a bit more about yourself (your interests, work, or what you're passionate about), and consider including some photos or links to your other profiles so visitors have a fuller picture. Overall, it's a solid starting point — keep it up!

Hi Eve! I visited your blog (www.eve-blog.com). I like that it introduces itself as your blog and shares a personal detail — your favorite hobby is hiking — which gives readers an immediate sense of who you are. To make it more compelling, you could add some actual blog posts (e.g., write-ups of your hiking trips with photos and places to visit), a short bio, and links to your social media. A personal touch like a favorite trail or a recent trip highlight would make it feel much more alive. Overall, a friendly and promising start — I'd love to read more!
